description: Owner issues a share code; HTTP 200 with {url, code, expiresAt}. URL is path-relative; code is the JWT; expiresAt is the far-future default 2100-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.
nodeBaselineNotes: Node hard-codes expiresAt to year 2100. Java preserves the default for compatibility and additionally persists a row in ds_session_share (ADR-0001).
